assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 Sony SAB 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：Sony Pictures Networks India / Sony Entertainment Television。企业隶属关系链。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言（印地语）。
  6. 主要内容类别（电视喜剧节目）。
  7. 内容供应模式：广播电视机构的节目存档。
  8. 代表性系列，例如 Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，Sony SAB 排名第 5 名，历史累计观看量约为 147B（1470 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 Sony SAB 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
Sony SAB YouTube Channel — Comprehensive Dossier

(1) Stable Channel ID and Canonical URL:
• Channel ID: UC6-F5tO8uklgE9Zy8IvbdFw
• Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6-F5tO8uklgE9Zy8IvbdFw
• Handle: @sonysab (also @sabtv on some YouTube surfaces)
Sources: YouTube channel page [1], Social Blade [2]

(2) Operator and Corporate Chain:
• Owned and operated by Sony Pictures Networks India Private Limited (SPNI), legal name Culver Max Entertainment Pvt. Ltd. since October 2022
• SPNI is an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Sony Pictures Entertainment, which is itself a subsidiary of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation, Japan
• Sony acquired SAB TV from Sri Adhikari Brothers in March 2005 and rebranded it as Sony SAB
Sources: Wikipedia — Sony Pictures Networks [3], Wikipedia — Sony SAB [4], Variety [5]

(3) Channel Creation Date and Earliest Still-Public Upload:
• Channel created: August 4, 2007 (confirmed by Social Blade, vidIQ, Wikitubia, Kaggle metadata)
• Earliest verified still-public upload: 'Mrs. Tendulkar - Episode 2 - 1st Feb 2011', uploaded February 3, 2011 (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=krnP8AvA2Ao). As of the Wayback Machine's first capture (June 9, 2013), the channel already had 11,520 videos, but many pre-2011 uploads appear to have been removed or made private over time.
• Wikitubia states uploads occurred 'sometime between 2007-2012' but does not identify specific surviving titles.
Sources: Social Blade [2], Wikitubia [6], YouTube video page [7], Wayback Machine [8]

(4) Operating Location and Displayed Country:
• Country displayed: India (IN)
• Headquartered: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
Sources: Wikipedia — List of most-viewed YouTube channels [9], vidIQ [10]

(5) Language:
• Primary language: Hindi
Sources: Wikipedia — List of most-viewed YouTube channels [9], Routenote [11]

(6) Primary Content Category:
• Category: Entertainment
• Described on-channel as 'a leading Hindi GEC [General Entertainment Channel]' focused on 'diverse storytelling & evoking real emotions'; programming is predominantly comedy/sitcom (family entertainment)
Sources: YouTube about page [1], Routenote [11], Wikipedia — Sony SAB [4]

(7) Content Supply Model:
• Broadcaster archives: The channel uploads full episodes from its linear TV channel (Sony SAB), including complete runs of former shows (e.g., 'Old is Gold | Office Office' playlist with 165 videos, 'Yes Boss - All Episodes', TMKOC full-episode playlists with 2,425+ videos). A 2020 Reddit post confirmed 'Sony SAB TV is uploading the complete series on its YouTube channel' for Office Office. Playlists systematically cover mid-to-late episode ranges of legacy shows.
Sources: YouTube playlist [12], Reddit discussion title [13], Wayback snapshot [8]

(8) Representative Series:
• Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah (TMKOC): Indian sitcom/comedy, premiered July 28, 2008, original language Hindi, network Sony SAB. One of India's longest-running TV series with 4,800+ episodes. Official full-episode playlist on Sony SAB (PL6Rtnh6YJK7ZFhouqhrvP3Sx0U7qxdzJi) with 2,425 videos and 207M+ views. Also has dedicated spin-off channels.
• Other representative shows available on the channel: Jijaji Chhat Per Hai, Baalveer Returns, Maddam Sir, FIR, Chidiya Ghar, Lapataganj, Yes Boss, Office Office, Bhakharwadi
Sources: Wikipedia — TMKOC [14], Wikipedia — List of programmes broadcast by Sony SAB [15], YouTube playlist [12]

Additional Key Metrics:
• Subscribers: ~106 million
• Lifetime views: ~148 billion (Social Blade, September 2026)
• Total videos: ~115,000+
• Global rank: #5 most-viewed YouTube channel (Wikipedia, June 2026)
• Communitrics September 2, 2026 snapshot of ~147B lifetime views aligns with these figures
Sources: Social Blade [2], Wikipedia [9]
